description: The file is a PHP web page that renders a Wi-Fi Spectrum Analyzer interface with embedded JavaScript for handling spectrum scan data, updating the UI, and interacting with backend PHP scripts via AJAX.

methods.name: spanTable
methods.description: Recursively merges table cells with identical content in specified column range.

methods.name: ajax_spec_analyzer
methods.description: Performs an AJAX call to retrieve Wi-Fi spectrum data, updates the HTML table with the data, and manages UI element visibility.

methods.name: popUp
methods.description: Opens a new popup window with specified URL.
